✅ SOLUTION: The Workload Identity Pool is corrupted. We need to delete it
   and create a fresh one.

⚡ RUN THIS ONE COMMAND RIGHT NOW:

   bash ./.github/workflows/RECOVER_WIF_PROVIDER.sh

   This script will:
   ✓ Automatically delete the corrupted pool and provider
   ✓ Create a fresh Workload Identity Pool
   ✓ Create a new OIDC Provider with correct configuration
   ✓ Create the service account
   ✓ Grant all permissions
   ✓ Output the 3 values you need

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📋 WHAT HAPPENS NEXT:

After running the script, it will show you output like:

   GCP_PROJECT_ID = random-fuck-work
   
   GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER = 
   projects/605371248588/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-pool/providers/github-provider
   
   GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL = 
   github-actions-sa@random-fuck-work.iam.gserviceaccount.com

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📝 THEN ADD THESE 3 VARIABLES TO GITHUB:

1. Go to: https://github.com/jhderojasUVa/randomfuckwork/settings/variables/actions

2. Click "New repository variable" 3 times and add:
   
   Name: GCP_PROJECT_ID
   Value: random-fuck-work
   
   Name: GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER
   Value: (paste the full value from script output)
   
   Name: GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
   Value: github-actions-sa@random-fuck-work.iam.gserviceaccount.com

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🚀 THEN TRIGGER THE PIPELINE:

   git push origin main

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   - Recovery script: 2-3 minutes

   - First pipeline run: 10 minutes
